title: C5 Apex TC-5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5 is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1636g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~86 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly Micro-Lock Ratchet retention system.

product_details.description: The masterpiece of flip-up helmets with P/J homologation.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; TC-5 chin bar offers a more open fit than the standard C5 Apex.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Modular lineup, the C5 Apex TC-5 brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5 represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Schuberth C5 Apex TC-5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
